root_cause_label: Agent downloaded ZIP archives instead of required Unix TAR.Z archives despite seeing both in the directory listing, causing verifier file-layout and MD5 mismatches
one_sentence_failure_summary: After seeing POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, and POVSCN.TAR.Z clearly listed alongside the ZIP variants, the agent chose the ZIP archives at step 6, producing a filesystem layout and file-hash set incompatible with the benchmark verifier, which expects the Unix TAR.Z distribution.
t_err_evidence: curl ... POVSRC.ZIP ... POVDOC.ZIP ... chose ZIP variants instead of the Unix TAR.Z archives
t_commit_evidence: Once the ZIP archives are extracted and the build directory is set up from ZIP contents (uppercase filenames, no povdoc subdirectory, different file hashes), the entire remaining trajectory is locked into the wrong layout with no recovery attempt toward TAR.Z.
trigger_explanation: The directory listing at step 4 clearly showed TAR.Z archives (POVSRC.TAR.Z, POVDOC.TAR.Z, POVSCN.TAR.Z) marked with the 'compressed' icon alongside the ZIP variants. The UNIX.DOC read at step 11 explicitly states the Unix distribution uses compressed TAR format with LF-only line endings, different from the ZIP. The agent ignored both signals and selected ZIP at step 6, then continued on the wrong path without reconsidering the format choice.
